content.title: Plan Your Visit
content.text: A Major Return to AroniminkThis is your chance to attend the first PGA Championship in Philadelphia since 1962, when Gary Player claimed the first of his two PGA Championship titles. Join us at Aronimink Golf Club to witness the strongest field in golf compete for a major championship. Learn more about what Philadelphia has to offer while you are here! Plan Your Visit to Newtown SquareKnown for its historic charm, modern activities, and charming architecture, Newtown Square offers a spacious, suburban feel. When you are not at Aronimink Golf Club, you can enjoy convenient access to a variety of shops and dining options, just fifteen miles west of Philadelphia.Explore what Delaware County has to offer by visiting the official tourism website, Visit Delco Explore the City of Brotherly LovePhiladelphia, known as the “Birthplace of America,” is a vibrant arts city with many museums, theaters, and public art installations. The city is famous for its cheesesteaks, pretzels, and diverse food scene. With passionate sports fans and a year celebrating the 250th anniversary of America’s founding in 1776, the PGA Championship is set to be an unforgettable experience.To learn more about Philadelphia, visit the official visitor website for travel and tourism, Visit PhillyExplore what Delaware County has to offer by visiting the official tourism website, Visit Delco On Location Travel PackagesBuy NowOfficial Travel Packages Include:An Official Championship+ Ticket for single or multi-day access to Aronimink Golf Club.Hotel accommodations conveniently located, paired with roundtrip daily transportation to the tournament grounds.Exclusive access to On Location’s dedicated on-site event staff, providing personalized assistance throughout your experience.An Official PGA Championship Souvenir Gift to commemorate your experience.A seamless and elevated PGA Championship experience — from arrival to final round.
